en.sayed-ali-raza: Beware; the earth which bears you and the sky which overshadows you are obedient to their Sustainer (Allāh).
They have not been bestowing their blessings on you for any feeling of pity on you or inclination towards you, nor for any good which they expect from you,
but they were commanded to bestow benefits on you and they are obeying, and were asked to maintain your good and so they are maintaining it.
